name: rolling-context
description: Rolling context compression - old messages get summarized, recent messages stay verbatim. Never hit the context wall. /roll shows status and toggles it (per session, or --global) at once, even mid-turn, without a Claude turn - subagents follow the session that spawned them, and nothing already compressed is thrown away. Trigger, target and how long unused compressions are kept are set in /config.

trigger_tokens.title: Compress when context exceeds (tokens)
trigger_tokens.description: Once a request reports more input tokens than this, older messages are summarized in the background. Applies from the next request.

target_tokens.title: Recent context kept verbatim (tokens)
target_tokens.description: How much of the most recent conversation stays word for word after a compression. Kept below the trigger (capped at half of it otherwise).

retention.title: Delete unused compressions after
retention.description: A stored compression that has not been injected into any request for this long is deleted from memory and disk. Never keeps them while the proxy runs (at most 64 survive a restart).

status_line.title: Show status line
status_line.description: The row under the prompt says whether compression is on for this session and what it has saved.

controls.title: Show the controls under the prompt
controls.description: Buttons beside the status under the prompt (one compact RC line above it where no row under the prompt is drawn): on/off for this session, Restart and Settings (these options, in a pane). They work mid-turn.
